confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Food and beer anchors are the most reliable. Cocktail and wine_glass are set from the beer price because direct knowledge is weaker. Accommodation has the widest range, and regional conditions in July 2026 could move it sharply. FX: the newest RBA figure I could surface is dated 20 March 2026, taken from search-result text describing the RBA page, which I did not open directly. A third-party site reports 0.6979 for 9 October 2026, which I could not verify. The server should refresh the rate before converting.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single exact comparator. Tel Aviv is among the costliest cities in the region, so high-cost Western European cities were used as a loose reference for dining, coffee and beer. Cocktail and wine prices follow the beer price. Accommodation reflects Tel Aviv's dense, high-demand summer market rather than a specific city.
